Header.Name: Source
Header.Description: Minimum and mandatory metadata elements common to all resources.

Element.name: nameOrTitle
Element.clariah:label: Source's key title
Element.clariah:explanation: Enter the source's key title, also used as folder title, the same entered in the Zotero "Extra" field. See documentation at: https://edu.nl/avfnw

Element.name: mainType
Element.clariah:label: Source's main type
Element.clariah:explanation: Select the source's main type. See documentation at: https://edu.nl/avfnw

Element.name: additionalSourceType
Element.clariah:label: Source's additional type
Element.clariah:explanation: Select the source's additional type. See documentation at: https://edu.nl/avfnw

Element.name: internalType
Element.clariah:label: Source's reliability type
Element.clariah:explanation: Select the source's internal type. See documentation at: https://edu.nl/avfnw

Element.name: accessURL
Element.clariah:label: Source's cloud link
Element.clariah:explanation: Find the link to the folder in Research Drive and paste it here. See documentation at: https://edu.nl/avfnw

Element.name: zoteroGroupItemLink
Element.clariah:label: Zotero group item link
Element.clariah:explanation: Find the link to the source's reference in Zotero and paste it here. See documentation at: https://edu.nl/avfnw

Component.name: DateNormalized
Component.clariah:label: Primary source's date(s)
Component.clariah:explanation: Enter the date in which a primary source was written. Do not enter for secondary or tertiary sources. This component allows you to enter the dates if they are certain or uncertain. In case they are uncertain, enter your interpretation about how this date should be normalized. These dates will be added as "floruit" periods to the persons or groups that appear in the source. See documentation at: https://edu.nl/avfnw

Element.name: datePrecision
Element.clariah:explanation: Select the type of precision that applies to your normalized date. This helps validate that dateStart/dateEnd are filled correctly. See documentation at: https://edu.nl/avfnw

Element.name: dateStart
Element.clariah:explanation: Enter earliest possible date in EDTF format. Rules: 1) For an EXACT date: enter the date in dateStart, leave dateEnd empty. 2) For a RANGE: enter earliest in dateStart, latest in dateEnd. 3) For "BEFORE X": leave dateStart empty, enter X in dateEnd. 4) For "AFTER Y": enter Y in dateStart, leave dateEnd empty. 5) EDTF uncertainty markers (?, ~, %) can be used in either field, follow the instructions here: https://knaw.sharepoint.com/:w:/s/PRJ-Brievenportaal/IQB7jUVOq98BR4Oy786Ch8n1AcilMidno3GLLVdmgUaYF-8?e=FBjVTA

Element.name: dateEnd
Element.clariah:explanation: Enter latest possible date in EDTF format. See rules in documentation of field "dateStart". For EDTF conventions, follow the instructions here: https://knaw.sharepoint.com/:w:/s/PRJ-Brievenportaal/IQB7jUVOq98BR4Oy786Ch8n1AcilMidno3GLLVdmgUaYF-8?e=FBjVTA

Element.name: noteDate
Element.clariah:explanation: Add any clarifying notes related to the dates. These notes may be for internal or external use (t.b.d.)

Element.name: confidenceValue
Element.clariah:explanation: How confident you (or an algorithm) that this date is normalised correctly.

Component.name: RecordWorkflowStatus
Component.clariah:label: Source work status
Component.clariah:explanation: Select the current work status for this source. See documentation at: https://edu.nl/avfnw

Element.name: recordStatus
Element.clariah:label: Source status
Element.clariah:explanation: Select the most specific type. See documentation at: https://edu.nl/avfnw

Component.name: Note
Component.clariah:explanation: Use notes for any additional information or action points related to the source. See documentation at: https://edu.nl/avfnw

Element.name: noteType
Element.clariah:label: Note type
Element.clariah:explanation: Select the most specific type. See documentation at: https://edu.nl/avfnw
